text: Kerrin Leoni has resigned as Labour's candidate in Tāmaki Makaurau and is now counted as an independent.
Near ties now say "too close to call", and moving a party to another side no longer changes anyone's seats.
You can now share your forecast, with your settings, from the Share button.
Every electorate poll is now linked on its seat card, and some poll figures were corrected.
Added the 1News–Verian poll (15–19 Oct). It's now the default.
Te Tai Tokerau and Mount Albert updated from new electorate polls.
